create.name: Mahamudra Centre for Universal Unity
create.bio:
Mahamudra Centre is a Tibetan Buddhist retreat centre in the Colville Valley, towards the top of the Coromandel Peninsula in New Zealand's North Island. It is an affiliate of the FPMT, the international Gelugpa network founded by Lama Yeshe and Lama Zopa Rinpoche, and was begun in the early 1980s by two Colville residents, Roy Fraser and Sally Barraud, who bought a farmhouse and land on their teacher's advice. Volunteers turned the property into a small sanctuary of eight acres with a gompa, a stupa with a meditation room beneath it, solitary retreat huts and a Dharma library.

Its programme is taught mostly by visiting FPMT-registered teachers, among them Venerable Robina Courtin, Venerable Tony Beaumont, Venerable Thubten Khadro and Venerable Losang Gendun. On the land it runs residential retreats such as week-long silent retreats in calm abiding and mind training and weekend retreats on the practice of Chenrezig, and it offers guided or self-directed private retreats in its huts all year. Online, it hosts the FPMT's Discovering Buddhism modules and its four-year In-Depth Meditation Training on Zoom, and its regular pujas can be joined remotely. Its YouTube channel holds recorded teachings from past retreats.

courses.title: Silent Meditation Retreat ~ Stillness & Mind Training
courses.description: Six days held in silence that pair calm-abiding meditation with Tibetan mind-training, learning to steady attention and to meet thoughts and emotions with patience and kindness. Open to people of any background.

courses.title: Chenrezig Weekend Retreat ~ Awakening the Heart of Compassion
courses.description: A weekend introduction to the Tibetan practice of Chenrezig, the Buddha of compassion, led by Venerable Thubten Khadro, with meditation, simple visualisation and chanting of his six-syllable mantra.

courses.title: Discovering Buddhism
courses.description: The FPMT's foundation programme in Tibetan Mahayana Buddhism, taught live on Zoom by Venerable Thubten Khadro in five-week modules on topics such as the mind, how to meditate and the graduated path. Each module has weekly teachings, guided meditations and a practice day, and students can join at any module.

courses.title: Year 4 Term 1 - FPMT In-Depth Meditation Training
courses.description: A thirteen-session online term of the FPMT's four-year meditation training with Venerable Losang Gendun, combining weekly guided meditation with lectures. Meant for students who already know the Dharma well.

courses.title: Private Retreats
courses.description: Stays in self-contained huts on the land, either as short guided retreats with two led meditations and a loose daily plan for those new to retreat, or as silent self-structured retreats of any length for experienced practitioners.

free_resources.title: Pujas and Online Practices
free_resources.description: Regular prayer and offering rituals on auspicious days of the Tibetan lunar calendar, held at the centre and open to join through Zoom.
